name: San Jose (United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of gold, white and blue in the ratio 1:4:1, the white charged with the city seal.
history: San Jose is the most populous city in the San Francisco Bay Area and the 13th-most populous in the United States. The current flag has been official since 1984, adopted on 5 June 1984 according to English Wikipedia; it replaced a 1969 flag by historian Clyde Arbuckle that bore the inscription SAN JOSÉ, CALIFORNIA.
